description: Exploit and committee crux: on the E004 recipe (10 epochs, no cutout, LS 0.1, alternating flip, max-autotune plus CUDA graph), change only the random-translate amplitude from 4 px to 2 px. Everything else, including the epoch count, stays fixed. W4 claims translate helps, but every run so far used translate 4, so this tests whether translate 4 still over-regularizes a net that under-fits at 10 epochs, as cutout and LS 0.2 did.
